### The Third Heaven
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-daily-devotion-oct-16-2012.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 12:2
Points:
- Scientific instruments and space telescopes can study the cosmos, but they cannot observe the third heaven.
- Scripture distinguishes three heavens: the earthly atmosphere, outer space with stars and galaxies, and the third heaven.
- The third heaven is the transcendent dwelling place of God Himself.
- While people often imagine God's presence as unimaginably remote, it may be closer than we think.

### To Heaven and Back with No Fanfare
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/to-heaven-and-back-with-no-fanfare
Passage: 2 Corinthians 12:1-5
Points:
- Unlike people who capitalize on near-death or mystical experiences for fame, Paul mentions his heavenly ascent only once.
- Paul speaks in the third person to avoid exalting himself over an experience he was not even allowed to describe.
- True Christian validity rests on joyful endurance in weakness and suffering rather than dramatic spiritual encounters.
- Biblical faith is anchored in public, readable, and testable truth rather than private mystical claims.
